Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As part of our onboarding checklist we'd like to confirm Redwood's subprocessor notification cadence and the objection process for additions to the processor list. Attached is our canonical list of processors we need to validate. High-level asks: 1) confirm the notification window you provide for third-party additions, 2) outline the objection/quiet period process, and 3) confirm whether execution of any DPA addendums happens via DocuSign (preferred) or AdobeSign.

We also have a brief question about how you classify low-risk tooling (monitoring, logging). Do those fall under silent acceptance?

Please share a contact for procurement and security who will own the timeline. Ideally we need confirmation before June 30 so our audit cycle can proceed.

Karthik / team — I reviewed Acme's spreadsheet and made notes. High-level summary:

- Tiering: I split processors into Tier 1 (data storage, encryption/KMS, identity), Tier 2 (analytics, APM), Tier 3 (monitoring, logging, CI/CD tools).
- Recommendation: 45-day notice for Tier 1 & 2; silent acceptance window for Tier 3 (30 days) unless Acme explicitly objects.
- Objection process: Acme raises objections to the DPO/security mailing list; we have a 15-business-day review window for potential mitigation or substitution. If unresolved, escalate to SOC/Legal.
- DPA execution: DocuSign is fine. For addenda that materially change data flows (KMS/HSM), require signed DPA amendment and an internal security checklist sign-off.

I've attached a proposed stakeholder matrix (karthik_proposed_matrix.csv) and inline redlines to the playbook. Two operational notes: 1) we should add a one-time onboarding form to capture processor purpose and data types; 2) add a hard stop for changes into non-US regions without prior approval.

Attachment: karthik_proposed_matrix.csv

Laura Bennett
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — procurement constraints and commercial notes:

- Standard enterprise window in our contracts is 45 days. We can offer 60 days for strategic customers but that creates SLA/commitment implications.
- Proposed compromise for Acme: keep 45-day notice, but add a 7-calendar-day expedited review option for Tier 1 items if Acme flags a compliance concern. That keeps our cadence but shows flexibility.
- DocuSign: procurement prefers DocuSign (audit trail + enterprise bindings). Recommend sending DPA amendment via DocuSign envelope (I can create the envelope if you confirm final doc).

Action items:
- Karthik: confirm we accept 45-day + 7-day expedited objection for Tier 1, silent acceptance for Tier 3.
- Laura: confirm whether the 15-business-day internal review for objections is scalable; if not, propose an SLA change.
- Aditya: provide the short description (1-2 lines) for each Tier 1 processor for the onboarding form.

Procurement note: added HubSpot link for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-98765 (please tag the record).

Best,

Hi Nina / Acme team — thanks for the list and patience while we reviewed internally. Summary of our proposed onboarding path:

- Notice window: Redwood provides 45 days' notice for subprocessor additions by default.
- Tiering & silent acceptance: Monitoring/logging and non-data processors will be treated as low-risk (silent acceptance) unless Acme flags them in the 45-day window.
- Objection workflow: If Acme objects to a Tier 1 processor, we will enter a 15-business-day review period. For urgent compliance concerns, Acme may request an expedited 7-calendar-day review for Tier 1 items. If no resolution is reached, the issue escalates to legal/SOC for final determination.
- Execution: DPA addenda/amendments will be executed via DocuSign. We will send a DocuSign envelope for any materially impactful processor additions (KMS, HSM, payment providers).

Next steps:
1) Acme: confirm acceptance of the 45-day + 7-day expedited option and whether you want silent acceptance for Tier 3.
2) Redwood: Grace will prepare the DocuSign envelope and Laura will share the final redlined playbook and stakeholder matrix.

DocuSign envelope (incoming): https://na1.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123docusignlink
HubSpot (tracking): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-98765

I'll follow up with the DocuSign envelope when ready. If you'd prefer AdobeSign, let us know but DocuSign is our standard.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer

Redwood Inference
